# Coordinate-Invariant Physical Inertia Validation

Issue #12183 corrects the existing public `validate_physical_inertia` helper in
`src/shared/python/estimation/dime_global_calibration.py`. It validates a supplied
finite symmetric 3-by-3 rotational inertia tensor; callers remain responsible
for body ownership, center-of-mass reference, source provenance and SI units
(kg m²). It does not extract tensors from native models or qualify their sources.

## Equations and Numerical Contract

For orthogonal body-frame rotation $R$, $I'=RIR^T$ preserves principal moments.
Let the sorted eigenvalues be $\lambda_1\leq\lambda_2\leq\lambda_3$.
The helper retains the existing strictly positive numerical condition
$\lambda_1>10^{-9}$ and requires
$\lambda_1+\lambda_2\geq\lambda_3-10^{-9}$.
These absolute tolerances retain the existing scale-dependent contract; they
are not material-property uncertainty estimates. Planar equality is allowed.
Symmetry uses absolute tolerance $10^{-7}$ with zero relative tolerance,
preventing large entries from masking an asymmetric tensor. The existing
NumPy symmetric eigensolver supplies all principal moments. On success the
numeric tensor values are returned unchanged; invalid tensors raise
`PreconditionError`. There is no projection, symmetrization or parameter repair.

## Regression Evidence and Reproduction

Rotating principal moments `(0.02, 0.02, 0.08)` by 45 degrees around the second
axis produces diagonal entries `(0.05, 0.02, 0.05)`. The old diagonal-only check
accepted this impossible tensor; its principal moments remain impossible.
Tests exercise two invalid principal-axis orderings, a valid rotated tensor,
planar equality, and an asymmetry previously hidden by relative tolerance.
Before the fix the focused new tests produced three failures and two passes.
After the fix the affected calibration and human-prior suites produced 25 passes:

```bash
python3 -m pytest -o addopts='' tests/unit/estimation/test_dime_global_calibration.py tests/unit/estimation/test_dime_human_priors.py -q
```

## Acceptance Boundary and Turnover

This is a helper-contract correction. No production source-admission call site
or optimizer-wide enforcement is introduced. Native source extraction,
mass/COM/frame checks, provenance-supported remediation and parameter-fit
constraints need separate reviewed integration and tests. A positive full-system
mass matrix alone does not establish physically realizable individual bodies.
Do not repair an imported tensor merely to obtain a passing gate. This change
does not qualify capture matching, muscle physiology, contact/grip, full-horizon
excitation replay or the 17-model/six-engine parity program. Calculation
registration and publication remain blocked.
